name_reason: Name follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> and accurately describes the behavior: set hp_current=0 for every runtime_char_array entry from a start index to party_member_count-1, then play the death animation. No Ghidra address residue in the name. Verified against disassembly (loop EDX*0x50 + 0x40 = hp_current write, CMP against party_member_count @0x53BEB) and 4 callers (all pass a constant start boundary: 0x14, 0x12, etc.).
purpose: Mass-kill trailing party slots: zero hp_current for runtime_char_array[start_char_idx .. party_member_count-1], then run the death animation/mark-dead pass once.
logic_summary: Watcom __CHK(8) stack-frame probe at entry. for (i = start_char_idx; (int)i < party_member_count; i++) data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr[i].hp_current = 0; then fd2_play_death_animation_and_mark_dead(). void return. Disasm confirms: stride 0x50 (LEA-by-shifts EAX=EDX*5<<4), write u16 0 at +0x40 (hp_current), loop bound at [0x53BEB], tail CALL 0x1db65.
